summary: Workflow structure is solid (pinned actions, proper permissions, sensible job dependencies, outputs). Bash scripts follow good patterns (shebang, set -euo pipefail, error handling via die()). Core weakness: matrix_generator.sh embeds 50+ lines of dense jq logic in one call, making it unreadable and hard to modify independently. Workflow redundantly installs actionlint (task notes it's pre-installed). Test harness clever but brittle: hardcoded exact-string assertions in run_act_tests.sh will break on any output change. Missing directory validation (no check if $FIXTURES exists before use). Would ship but maintainability concerns linger.
